{{Quote|Two recent human projects&mdash;the miners created for Tarshan Ring Excavations and the infiltration squads requested by the Lords of Purala IV&mdash;began with trials of sterile clones, as requested by both customers.|Hali Ke's internal memorandum|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Purala IV''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Purala system/Legends|Purala system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the [[Lords of Purala IV]] requested that the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> create [[Human/Legends|Human]] clones who would serve the Puralan [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] as members of infiltration [[Squad/Legends|squads]]. In 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the Kaminoan<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|205|Ke, Hali}}</ref> [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Hali Ke]] noted the request of the Lords of Purala IV in an internal memorandum.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Purala IV was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding the astronomical object was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Purala [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Purala IV, in grid square Q-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
